rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the saltwater of the sea or ocean.

example.english: The seawater is cold, so don’t go into the water yet.
example.jyutping: hoi2 seoi2 hou2 dung3 m4 hou2 lok6 seoi2 zyu6

rows.note: Use this when contrasting seawater with fresh water or emphasizing that the water is salty.

example.english: Seawater and fresh water taste completely different.
example.traditional: 鹹水同淡水嘅味道完全唔同。
example.jyutping: haam4 seoi2 tung4 daam6 seoi2 ge3 mei6 dou6 jyun4 cyun4 m4 tung4
